title: Type-26 Banshee (Halo)
intro: The Banshee is the fictional ground-support flyer of the Covenant in the Halo games. The pilot lies face down inside a closed, mirror-like cover and does not look through a windscreen. The games give it gamepad or mouse controls, not a modelled cockpit, so this guide explains the game controls.

areas.name: Prone cockpit
areas.text: The pilot lies face down inside a closed cover.

panels.name: Prone cockpit
panels.text: Instead of sitting, the Banshee pilot lies face down in a cradle.
panels.context: The cover is closed, so the pilot sees the world in another way than through a window.

controls.name: Prone cradle
controls.text: A cradle in which the pilot lies face down on the stomach.
controls.context: It is a design of the alien Covenant, very different from human cockpits.

controls.name: Closed cowling
controls.text: A closed, reflective cover over the pilot with no visible windscreen.
controls.context: In the games the player sees the view from outside the Banshee.

panels.name: Weapon pods
panels.text: Two pods with the Banshee's weapons, under the body.
panels.context: The Banshee attacks targets on the ground and in the air.

controls.name: Plasma cannons
controls.text: The plasma cannons are the main weapon, fired with the primary fire button.
controls.context: They fire fast bolts of hot plasma at the target.

controls.name: Fuel rod cannon
controls.text: The fuel rod cannon is the heavy weapon, fired with the secondary fire button.
controls.context: It fires slower, explosive shots for bigger targets.

areas.name: Game controls
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Aim and fire
panels.text: In the games: the aim stick or mouse and the fire buttons.
panels.context: On a joystick set these become the stick and its buttons.

controls.name: Aim / flight direction
controls.text: Moving the aim up and down tips the Banshee's nose; moving it left and right turns it. The Banshee flies where the player aims.
controls.context: In the games this is the aim stick of the gamepad or the mouse.

controls.name: Primary fire
controls.text: This button fires the Banshee's plasma cannons.
controls.context: It is the game's normal fire button.

controls.name: Secondary fire
controls.text: This button fires the Banshee's fuel rod cannon.
controls.context: It is the game's second weapon button.

panels.name: Speed and boost
panels.text: In the games: the move stick (forward / back) and the boost button.
panels.context: They set how fast the Banshee flies.

controls.name: Forward / back
controls.text: Forward makes the Banshee fly faster, back slows it down.
controls.context: In the games this is the move stick pushed forward or back.

controls.name: Boost
controls.text: This button gives a burst of extra speed.
controls.context: Boost helps the Banshee to escape or to rush at a target.
